description: Frontend web application: full-screen Google Maps-style Leaflet map, Street View preview card, Photo Sphere Viewer panorama, navigation arrows, minimap, keyboard controls, and responsive layout. Depends on FEAT-001 (package.json, tsconfig, vite.config). Independent of FEAT-002 during build — the API client uses fetch and works against the Vite dev proxy.
steps: Create apps/web/src/i18n/id.ts: export const i18n object with all Indonesian UI strings. Keys: appTitle:'Street View Takengon', clickHint:'Klik garis biru untuk memilih lokasi', backToMap:'Kembali ke Peta', forward:'Maju', back:'Mundur', report:'Laporkan', streetView:'Street View', loading:'Memuat...', noPhoto:'Foto tidak tersedia', reportTitle:'Laporkan Masalah', reportPrivacy:'Privasi (wajah/plat)', reportWrongLocation:'Lokasi salah', reportOther:'Lainnya', reportSend:'Kirim Laporan', reportSent:'Laporan terkirim', nearLabel:'Dekat', attribution:'© OpenStreetMap contributors, CARTO'. File: apps/web/src/i18n/id.ts

Create apps/web/src/api/client.ts: typed API client using native fetch. Functions: getCoverage(bbox:{minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat}):Promise<GeoJSON.FeatureCollection>. getNearestPhoto(lat,lon,maxM?):Promise<PhotoDetail|null>. getPhoto(id:number):Promise<PhotoDetail>. searchPlaces(q:string):Promise<Place[]>. submitReport(body:{photoId,type,note?}):Promise<{id:number}>. Types: PhotoDetail{id,url,thumbUrl,lat,lon,headingDeg,northOffsetDeg,projection,near,neighbors:Neighbor[]}. Neighbor{id,bearingDeg,distanceM}. Place{id,name,category,lat,lon}. All functions throw on non-2xx with error.message from response JSON. File: apps/web/src/api/client.ts

Create apps/web/src/map/map.ts: initializes and exports a Leaflet map. export function initMap(containerId:string):L.Map. Creates map centered at [4.62, 96.84] zoom 13. Adds tile layer from import.meta.env.VITE_TILE_URL (fallback CartoCDN voyager URL), attribution from VITE_TILE_ATTRIBUTION. Disables default zoom control (re-added bottom-right). Returns map instance. File: apps/web/src/map/map.ts

Create apps/web/src/map/coverage.ts: export function loadCoverage(map:L.Map, onPhotoSelect:(id:number)=>void):void. Calls getCoverage with current map bbox + 0.02 degree padding. Creates a L.GeoJSON layer with style:{color:'#2A7BE4',weight:5,opacity:0.8}. On layer click: calculates nearest point on clicked linestring using L.GeometryUtil (or manual projection), calls getNearestPhoto with that lat/lon, calls onPhotoSelect with returned photo id. Re-fetches on moveend if zoom>=11. File: apps/web/src/map/coverage.ts

Create apps/web/src/map/marker.ts: export class PositionMarker. Constructor(map:L.Map). show(lat,lon,headingDeg:number):void — places/moves an orange circle marker at position + a direction wedge (CSS-rotated triangle div icon) pointing headingDeg. hide():void. The wedge icon is an L.DivIcon with a triangle SVG rotated via CSS transform. Color #F08A1C. File: apps/web/src/map/marker.ts

Create apps/web/src/ui/card.ts: export class StreetViewCard. Constructor(containerId:string, onOpen:(photoId:number)=>void). render(photo:PhotoDetail|null):void — if null shows clickHint text. If photo: shows thumbnail img, near text, 'Street View' label. Clicking card calls onOpen(photo.id). Styles: fixed bottom-left, max-width 270px, border-radius 12px, box-shadow, white background. On mobile (<600px): full width minus 24px margin. File: apps/web/src/ui/card.ts

Create apps/web/src/viewer/panorama.ts: export class PanoramaViewer. Uses @photo-sphere-viewer/core Viewer. Constructor(containerId:string, onNeighborClick:(id:number)=>void, onBack:()=>void). open(photo:PhotoDetail):void — creates/reuses PSV Viewer in containerId. Sets panorama to photo.url with panoData:{fullWidth,fullHeight} for equirectangular. Applies northOffsetDeg as sphereCorrection.pan. First loads thumb as low-res then swaps to full URL. Calls prefetchNeighbors(photo.neighbors). close():void — hides viewer container. getCurrentYaw():number — returns current viewer yaw in degrees (compass heading). setYaw(headingDeg:number):void. Private prefetchNeighbors: preloads thumbnail URLs into Image objects. File: apps/web/src/viewer/panorama.ts

Create apps/web/src/viewer/arrows.ts: export class NavigationArrows. Constructor(viewerEl:HTMLElement, onNavigate:(photoId:number)=>void). update(neighbors:Neighbor[], currentHeadingDeg:number, viewerYaw:number):void — for each neighbor compute relativeAngle = normalizeAngle(neighbor.bearingDeg - viewerYaw). Show arrow only if |relativeAngle| < 70. Each arrow is a div absolutely positioned in the lower half of the viewer: translateX by sin(relativeAngle)*40vw, a white arrow SVG (chevron-up) rotated by relativeAngle degrees. Clicking navigates. clear():void. File: apps/web/src/viewer/arrows.ts

Create apps/web/src/viewer/minimap.ts: export class MiniMap. Constructor(containerId:string). init(map:L.Map):void — creates a small Leaflet map (160×160px) cloned from main map, same tile layer, no controls except attribution. update(lat,lon,headingDeg,fovDeg:number=75):void — moves a DivIcon marker showing position + a SVG FOV cone (wedge) rotated to headingDeg. The cone shows the ±fovDeg/2 field of view. File: apps/web/src/viewer/minimap.ts

Create apps/web/src/ui/controls.ts: export class ViewerControls. Constructor(containerEl:HTMLElement, callbacks:{onBack,onForward,onBackward,onReport}). render():void — creates DOM: back button top-left (← Kembali ke Peta), location info top-right (near label), forward/backward buttons bottom-right (Maju/Mundur), report button bottom-right. setLocationLabel(text:string):void. Keyboard handler on document: ArrowUp/w → onForward, ArrowDown/s → onBackward, Escape → onBack. All buttons ≥44px, high-contrast. File: apps/web/src/ui/controls.ts

Create apps/web/index.html: minimal HTML5 page. <head>: charset UTF-8, viewport, title 'Street View Takengon', links for Leaflet CSS, a <link> for viewer CSS. <body>: #map (full-screen), #street-view-container (hidden, full-screen absolute), #card-container, #minimap-container. <script type='module' src='/src/main.ts'>. File: apps/web/index.html

Create apps/web/src/main.ts: application entry point. Orchestrates all modules: 1. initMap('map'). 2. new StreetViewCard('card-container', openStreetView). 3. new PositionMarker(map). 4. loadCoverage(map, onPhotoSelect). 5. new PanoramaViewer('street-view-container', navigateTo, closeStreetView). 6. new NavigationArrows(viewerEl, navigateTo). 7. new MiniMap('minimap-container'), minimap.init(map). 8. new ViewerControls(viewerEl, {onBack:closeStreetView,onForward,onBackward,onReport}). State machine: mapMode (map visible, viewer hidden) <-> viewerMode (viewer visible, map hidden, minimap visible). onPhotoSelect(id): fetches photo, updates card. openStreetView(id): fetches photo, opens viewer, shows arrows, shows minimap, updates position marker. navigateTo(id): fetches photo, updates viewer preserving yaw. closeStreetView(): hides viewer, shows map. onForward/onBackward: finds neighbor with smallest/largest relativeAngle and navigates. File: apps/web/src/main.ts
acceptance_criteria: cd apps/web && npm run build — zero TypeScript errors, dist/ produced
npm run dev:web — dev server starts at localhost:5173
Opening http://localhost:5173 shows full-screen Leaflet map centered on Takengon (lat 4.62, lon 96.84)
Blue coverage lines appear after loadCoverage fetches from /api/coverage
Clicking coverage line opens Street View card bottom-left with thumbnail
Clicking card opens full-screen panorama viewer
Navigation arrows visible and clicking navigates to neighbor photo
Esc key closes viewer, returns to map
ArrowUp navigates forward, ArrowDown navigates backward
Minimap shows position dot and FOV cone that rotates as viewer yaw changes
Layout works at 360px viewport width (card spans full width minus 24px)
verification: cd apps/web && npm run build — exits 0, no TypeScript errors
